label.zh:
我们将与所有成员国联系，要求他们参加演习。

如果大量成员国拒绝此提议，联邦团结度将会降低，而[Root.GetName]将损失影响力。
label.en:
All member states will be approached and asked to participate in the exercises.

If the proposal is widely rejected, Federation Cohesion will decrease and the [Root.GetName] will lose Influence.

label.zh: 完成联合演习将提高舰队效率，增加联邦经验。
